purpose: Machine-readable bindings from every equation in EN_TRAIN_CORRECTED_MATHEMATICAL_SPEC.md to its concrete repository source at 447f0dc. Every equation is stated in the form the repository executes; no equation has been generalized, simplified, or improved.

i.meaning: token position inside a K-window w, i in [start, end), start = w*K, end = min((w+1)*K, T)
i.note: bookkeeping index over the FAST CLOCK's per-token cadence

w.meaning: slow-clock window index, w in [0, W), W = ceil(T / K)
w.note: bookkeeping index over the SLOW CLOCK's window cadence

k.note: counts approved offline parameter updates during EN-TRAIN training; applied outside the forward path; never appears in Aeon's inference

S.note: not persisted across forward calls; each call reinitializes at aeon/hybrid.py:141-142

native_forward_process.FAST_CLOCK_binding: canonical fast clock (per-token substrate.step), see en_train_clock_mapping.json.fast_clock
native_forward_process.SLOW_CLOCK_binding: canonical slow clock (per-K-window recursion.step + broadcast + transformer.inject), see en_train_clock_mapping.json.slow_clock

equations.equation_ascii: x_{w,i} = emb_proj(emb_{w,i}) + cond_proj(h_{w-1})
r_{w,i}, substrate_{w,i} = SubstrateStep(x_{w,i}, substrate_{w,i-1})
s_w = s_proj( mean_{i in [start_w, end_w)} r_{w,i} )
t_w = t_all[:, end_w - 1, :]
e_w = mean_{i in [start_w, end_w)} emb_{w,i}    if recursion.use_embedding_input else None

quoted_code: e_w = emb[:, start:end, :].mean(dim=1) if self.recursion.use_embedding_input else None

equations.equation_ascii: (h_w, c_w) = RecursionStep(s_w, t_w, stopgrad(h_{w-1}), stopgrad(c_{w-1}), e_w)

quoted_code: h, c = self.recursion.step(s_w.float(), t_w.float(), h.detach(), c.detach(), e=e_w.float() if e_w is not None else None)

equations.equation_ascii: c_w = (1 - lambda) * c_{w-1} + lambda * tanh( h_{w-1} @ W_c^T )
h_w = tanh( W_s @ s_w + W_t @ t_w + optional(W_e @ e_w) + h_{w-1} @ W_h^T + c_w )

h_cond_w = h_{w-1};  inject_signal[:, i, :] = h_cond_w  for i in [start_w, end_w);  injected = transformer.inject(hidden, inject_signal);  logits = transformer.logits(injected) = lm_head(hidden + gamma * write_proj(inject_signal))

quoted_code: h_cond = h                                               # held state for this window (D1)

equations.equation_ascii: substrate_{w, end_w} <- detach( substrate_{w, end_w} )
equations.design_note: D2 — truncated BPTT at the slow-clock boundary (pre-existing)

equations.equation_ascii: sigma_max(W_h) < MARGIN_H  AND  sigma_max(W_c) < MARGIN_C

repository_source.quoted_code_note: MARGIN_H / MARGIN_C bind the W_h / W_c parameterization; audit() reports the current margins

equations.equation_ascii: K = 16;  W = ceil(T / K)
L_k(theta_k) = - ( sum_{(b,t) in M_k} log softmax(z_{b,t}(theta_k))[y_{b,t+1}] ) / |M_k|   with M_k[b,t] = attention_mask[b, t+1]
same as L_G but with M_k[b,t] = attention_mask[b, t+1] * response_mask[b, t+1]
g_k = grad_{theta_k} L_k(theta_k)
g_bar_k = g_k * min( 1, c / max( ||g_k||_2, eps ) )   with c = 1.0
theta_{k+1} = G_existing( theta_k, g_bar_k, q_k )
equations.rationale_for_fallback: correction order Section 4: 'If the current repository does not contain a native learned update operator G, do not invent one. In that case, G is the existing approved optimizer and gradient-control path.' Repository search confirms none exists in aeon/*.

equations.equation_ascii: theta_{k+1} != theta_k
architecture( F_{theta_{k+1}} ) = architecture( F_{theta_k} )
for every inference call c, theta_after(c) = theta_before(c)
